ascend-text: The temple, the blessings, everything you built this run — given back. What you receive for it never leaves you again.
blessings-empty: Nothing on offer. Build something, and something will be.
choir-cooldown: The choir is mid-office. It can be re-seated in {{time}}.
choir-note: The nave grants a saint their full strength, the transept half, the apse a quarter — penalties soften the same way. Re-seating costs a silence that grows each time.
devotion-note: Devotion: +{{percent}}%. Every trophy is worth 4%, and the Cherubim turn all of it into income — this list is the late game.
exchange-note: Prices move once a minute, awake or not. A unit is worth ten seconds of your rate, so the market scales with the temple rather than falling behind it.
garden-note: Plants grow in real time, whether or not this page is open. Mature plants standing next to each other sometimes make something new.
grace-spent: {{spent}} spent on the Ladder so far.
import-prompt: Paste a save. This replaces the current one.
ladder-share: {{percent}}% of your Grace counts, for +{{bonus}}% to everything, permanently.
ladder-warn: Grace does nothing until a Communion rung unlocks it. Buy First Communion before anything else.
manna-hint: Manna ripens on its own. Spend it raising a source.
manna-text: It ripens on its own, roughly once a day, and nothing you do with joy will hurry it. Spend it raising a source: +1% output per level, forever, through every ascension.
plot-empty: Empty bed — choose a seed first
plot-locked: Locked — raise the Olive Grove with Manna
prayers-said-note: Every prayer raises your mana ceiling and steadies your hand.
raise-note: Manna raises a source permanently: +1% output per level, and it survives every ascension. Levelling the Grove, Almshouse, Sanctuary and Scriptorium opens what is behind them.
save-note: The temple saves itself every {{seconds}} seconds, again shortly after you stop playing, and again the moment the tab is closed or backgrounded. You should never need the button below.
save-where: To your account, and to this browser as a fallback.
setting-confirm-note: An ascension gives the whole run back. Worth a second look.
setting-flourish-note: Stops the drifting motes, the breathing light and the looping pulses. Everything you need to see still moves.
setting-music-note: The temple soundtrack. Set to zero to stop it.
setting-sfx-note: Offerings, purchases, halos, harvests. Move the slider to hear it.
setting-sound-note: The soundtrack, the bells, and every chime below.
setting-steward-note: Spends spare joy on whatever pays for itself soonest, keeping a minute of income in reserve.
soil-cooldown: The ground can be turned again in {{time}}.
sources-empty: Tap the altar. Joy comes before comfort.
stall-clear-note: Costs the same silence as any other change.
strike-sinner: Strike this Sinner and reclaim {{held}} joy
trophy-secret-note: You will know it when you do it.
vigil-note: The garden, the market, the manna and the Sinners are not capped — they run for the whole time you are gone. A night away is worth more than the number above suggests.
vigil-sinner-note: Everything the Sinners are holding comes back, multiplied, the moment you strike them.
